department: Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences (GCB)

deadline.value: Enrolment at Bern closes 15 October, the 2026/27 date, which has passed; no 2027 date is stated. GCB applications close 15 December 2026, then 15 April and 15 August 2027.

also.quote: The next GCB Application deadline is 23:59 on December 15, 2026
The deadlines for application are April 15, August 15 and December 15
by October 15 for entry in the autumn term or March 31 for entry in the spring term

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must find a lab and a supervisor yourself before applying to the GCB.
supervisor.quote: candidates must themselves arrange for a research laboratory and a supervisor

funding.value: The supervisor pays the salary under SNSF guidelines, but no guaranteed funding for all students is stated.
funding.quote: The supervisor is responsible for the research project, the laboratory infrastructure, adequate supervision and the salary of the student according to SNSF guidelines

entry_route.value: A master's or licentiate from a Swiss university or ETH, or an equivalent degree, is needed for doctoral admission.
entry_route.quote: hold a master's degree or a licentiate from a Swiss university or Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, or an equivalent university degree

notes: Covers biology as well as biomedical sciences. Applicants must pass a GCB interview. Specialisations include Neuroscience, Cardiovascular Research and Cell Migration.
name: Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences (GCB)
